content: Each Intake and Work Unit checkpoint requires its own Human approval after exact artifact path, full validation result, and proposed commit message are shown.

Checkpoint creation validates through the owning manager, stages only the canonical package, detects path, symlink, repository, index, and validation-to-stage races, and emits a deterministic receipt.
Failure leaves no partial index or commit mutation; exact replay returns the original receipt while conflicting replay refuses safely.
Read-only inspection reconstructs and verifies the checkpoint in a fresh session, and worktree preparation uses the inspected Work Unit checkpoint commit as its base.

Missing, ambiguous, invalid, incomplete, non-ready, blocker-bearing, execution-context-invalid, or Intake-basis-invalid Work Units are refused with machine-readable reasons before branch, worktree, attempt, or scoped repository mutation.
Direct worktree preparation cannot bypass the same-id full-ready admission contract.
A valid ready Work Unit starts without repeating an execution question and persists revision, attempt, invocation chain, completed and pending steps, and inspected head.
Process or session interruption resumes the same revision and attempt and does not repeat completed non-idempotent side effects.
Transient operations use stable idempotency identity and bounded retry; exhausted or unrecoverable failures create evidence-backed blockers and transition out of working.
After blocker resolution, public commands resume the same revision and attempt; review is reachable only after all work, verification, and AI review gates pass.
All approved expected outputs are implemented within scope.
Focused checkpoint, admission, interruption, retry, and blocked recovery tests fail before implementation and pass afterward.
Relevant lifecycle, Intake, Work Unit manager, and worktree regressions pass.
Plugin validation and git diff checks pass.
Execution, verification, AI review, and Human-facing report evidence are registered in the Work Unit.

requiredEvidence: checkpoint success, refusal, race, replay, and inspection test results
admission pre-side-effect and direct-worktree bypass test results
interruption resume, idempotent retry, exhaustion, blocking, and blocker-resolution test results
relevant regression and plugin validation results
AI diff and lifecycle invariant review
